Contract:
A single temporary scratch file for the current SDD session — `specs/.sdd-session.md`, gitignored, not a deliverable. It lets a multi-step or multi-scope flow survive a context squeeze or a session break within the same piece of work; it is NOT carried between unrelated sessions. The kernel reads it on entry and updates it after each loaded directive. On the work finishing, it is discarded.
The `scale:` field carries the operator-confirmed SCALE (`AX_SCALE_PROPORTIONAL_DEPTH`) — the router writes it once at classification; every branch reads it as its depth parameter (interview depth, number of design alternatives, weight of the verification tail).
```markdown # SDD session — intent: scale: — operator-confirmed working set: - — — journal: - → open: ```
